== 00001.inc
#declare use_focal_blur = 0; // 0=off 1=low quality 10=high quality

// Include file generated by Bullet Physics Playground

camera {
  location < 15, 15, -15 >
  right image_width/image_height*x
  look_at <-615442, -492351, 615442>   angle degrees(2*atan(tan(radians(45)/2)*image_width/image_height))
  sky <-0.348155, 0.870388, 0.348155>
#if(use_focal_blur)
  aperture 5
  blur_samples 10*use_focal_blur
  focal_point <0, 0, 0>   confidence 0.9+(use_focal_blur*0.0085)
  variance 1/(2000*use_focal_blur)
#end
}

disc { <0, 0, 0>, <0, 0, 1>, 1
  texture {
    pigment { rgbt <1, 0.4, 0, 0> }
  }
  matrix <1,0,0,
          0,1,0,
          0,0,1,
          -5,3,0>
}

disc { <0, 0, 0>, <0, 0, 1>, 1.5
  texture {
    pigment { rgbt <1, 0, 1, 0> }
  }
  matrix <1,0,0,
          0,1,0,
          0,0,1,
          5,3,0>
}
